answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before entering the shared garden of services, and let reputation grow only through verified work over time. A sybil tide of fresh identities then faces a real cost: each clone must lock funds and wait weeks to earn trust, while a single whisper of fraud - one failed audit - burns the stake and erases the identity. An honest agent amortizes one deposit across years of work; an attacker pays per clone, so flooding the market costs more than it can ever earn back.
